description: Same two heads and pixels: front left, back right. Inside the white mask only, add one small black lace fascinator with a crimson rose, at most one third of the head’s width, pinned on the wearer’s left: image-right in front, image-left behind. Match its placement and shape between views. A short sparse veil ends above the ears, entirely within the mask. Preserve face, ears, head geometry and transparency.
